findings.summary: cors({ origin: '*', credentials: true }) is silently rejected by browsers; breaks cookie-based auth per ARCHITECTURE §5.4.
findings.suggested_fix: Narrow CORS origin to the SPA host via env (CORS_ORIGIN). Browsers ignore Access-Control-Allow-Credentials when Allow-Origin is '*' so session/refresh/csrf cookies silently fail.

findings.summary: vi.mock specifiers still point at '.ts' paths while SUT imports were rewritten to '.js'; mock factories may fail to intercept the renamed module IDs.
findings.suggested_fix: Update vi.mock('../../db/client.ts'|'../../shared/env.ts'|'./tokens.ts') to use the matching '.js' specifiers (or import-resolved IDs) and re-run vitest to confirm interception.

findings.summary: buildApp(env) accepts env as _env and ignores it; createAuthService/db/hasher all resolve env through module-level singletons, so the DI seam is illusory.
findings.suggested_fix: Either thread env into the inner constructors so integration tests can inject test config, or drop the env parameter and rename to buildApp() — document that env is a process-level singleton.

findings.summary: loadEnv(process.env) at boot duplicates the eager singleton in shared/env.ts:26; both invocations validate the env at import time.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the eager `export const env = loadEnv()` from shared/env.ts (preferred — restores DI per agent memory env_eager_load) OR drop the explicit loadEnv() call here. Today both run.
